a: Celery runs Python tasks asynchronously via brokers like Redis or RabbitMQ.
Background jobs should be safe to retry without duplicating side effects.
Visibility timeouts hide in-flight messages until ack or expiry.
Failed jobs after max retries go to a dead-letter queue for inspection.
Sidekiq is a popular background job processor for Ruby.
BullMQ is a Redis-based job queue for Node.js.
Most queues are at-least-once; design consumers to be idempotent.
Priority queues process urgent work before bulk/batch jobs.
Heartbeat/extend locks for long jobs so they are not requeued early.
